cover.title: A switch file for those readers
cover.overview: Write a switch file that hides expert steps and a second one that flags print paragraphs, then apply each in Author so you can see the difference.
cover.audience: New writers. Do the work in Oxygen, or on the labeled window if the app cannot open.

blocks.heading: A list of actions
blocks.body:
A **.ditaval** file is a switch file: a list of actions on your marks. The actions are **include**, **exclude**, and **flag**.

Attach it in Author to preview. You will use a switch file again in week 6 when you make a site or a PDF. Today you only preview.

If you cannot say what the file does, do not attach it.

Open the switch file in Text. It is a small file you can read. It is not only a hidden setting.

blocks.title: Profiling and Reuse
watchFor: A switch file attached to profiling
Hide vs flag in the UI

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Two switch files.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You deleted the expert step instead of filtering it, or a switch file has no action, or you cannot explain exclude vs flag.

Expected: Two switch files. Author view changes with the filter. Source still contains the expert step. Meanings file written.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Two switch files.
blocks.intro: How to Two switch files. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Two switch files
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Create ditaval/novice.ditaval: exclude audience=expert. Leave other marks alone (include them, or omit them).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Create ditaval/print-flag.ditaval: flag platform=print (a style or a color :  write what you picked).

image.alt: New document wizard in Oxygen XML Editor
image.caption: File > New. Pick a file type here. On day 1 you only need a blank project, not this wizard yet.
image.credit: Oxygen XML Editor User Guide, Syncro Soft

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: In Oxygen, apply novice.ditaval as the profiling filter for Author (DITA > Profiling / Conditional Text :  verify the label). The expert step should disappear or gray out per your setting.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Switch to print-flag.ditaval. The print paragraph should stay visible but flagged.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Write oxygen-bootcamp-work/week5/ditaval-explained.txt: exclude means ____. flag means ____. include means ____.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Do not delete the expert step from the source file.

blocks.summary: Two switch files. Author view changes with the filter. Source still contains the expert step. Meanings file written.

blocks.body: The lab is done. Prove it with the check. Use words from today only.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: Exclude vs flag: which one removes the chunk from what the reader sees?
blocks.why: exclude drops the content. flag keeps it and marks it. include keeps it.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: You applied the novice switch file in Author. Text view no longer has the expert step. What went wrong?
options: You edited or deleted source instead of filtering the view
A switch file always rewrites the page
blocks.why: A filter is a view. Source keeps the step.
